title: Carolina has love for her job
text: Our experience has been excellent, we could not have better guide than Carolina you rating the vocation for her work ,when she tells the whole story about the Alhambra is impressive, loving attentive and very watchful that we asked any questions we had, if you go to visit the Alhambra do not hesitate to ask about it you will not regret it.It is a charm always with a smile, let's go ten out of ten.

title: Best tour we've ever had!
text:
A magnificent guide and an unforgettable experience! 
Carolina is a super professional girl and has given us a magnificent tour. His knowledge, his charisma and his mastery of the subject make you see Granada with different eyes, and we will repeat when we return safely. 

Fully recommended!

title: What an amazing place

title: Thanks for an unforgettable experience
text: Wonderful Alhambra accompanied by friendly Carolina. On a rainy day but full of charm and haunting, our guide has told us a thousand and one stories. Very entertaining and interesting. It's flown past us. Besides, he has given us many tips for the city. Highly recommended.

title: Funny Alhambra
text: We did the legend tour with tickets to the Alhambra, we discovered a lot of historical data and anecdotes of the area. Many curious facts told in a very entertaining and funny way with our guide Carolina who despite being young knows a lot about Granada and the Alhambra you can see that she is passionate about her work. 100x100 recommended! We will repeat some more tours.Thanks Sultana tours
